name: Grids
author: pcppcp
description: Grids plays three parts, BD, SD and HH, from a map of drum patterns. Move the point around the map with X and Y and the patterns morph from one groove into the next. Fill sets how busy each part is, and Chaos adds random variation. It's pcppcp's port of Émilie Gillet's Grids module.
credits: pcppcp's port of Mutable Instruments Grids by Émilie Gillet (GPL-3.0-or-later), ported to kennel by Hundekraft
